review.note: The point is the P625 of Wikidata Q1192118, Battle of Chemulpo Bay, read on 2026-09-24. A9's second step gives nothing: the port the item names, Jemulpo (Q125696445), carries no coordinate, which is why M42 batch 47 refused this row. No `wikidata` key: a place claiming to be the battle would be the worse record. The atlas's `incheon` is the modern city on this bay, 17 km off; the article says the battle was fought off its coast.
